slides.title: The political timeline is not linear
slides.body: State formation, a stronger TRS state mandate, changing civic competition, and the 2023 change in government are distinct events.
slides.contribution: I would maintain an event ledger that separates electoral results, office changes, boundary changes and delivery milestones.
slides.logic: Results from different institutions document changing competition; they do not prove one stable electorate trajectory or a cause.
slides.limits: 2016/2020 municipal and 2018 summary figures are explicitly attributed reporting. No transfers of voters inferred.
slides.notes:

slides.logic: A documented institution-specific chain is more useful than assigning every urban outcome to one politician or department.

slides.title: A ballot is an institutional choice
slides.body: BJP won Malkajgiri, Secunderabad and Chevella; AIMIM won Hyderabad in the 2024 results examined here.
slides.contribution: I would keep Assembly, parliamentary and civic result series separate, then test possible explanations through approved research.

slides.notes:
